notes: Facing check, yaw 0 pitch 0 for the wheel. The wheel is placed with use_at on the top face of stone (308,120,310) -> wheel at 308,121,310; the hit face and the player yaw are recorded. Then a water bucket is used with use_item at pitch 60 (vanilla BucketItem path: the player raycast hits the top face of stone 308,120,309) -> water at 308,121,309 (north neighbour of the wheel). use_at is not used for the bucket: truth-ctl use-at goes through useItemOn, which buckets ignore. Block states of both, player yaw and the bucket count are compared.
